_meta.doc: Per OL_UNITS id: every person listed at an OL position (OL/T/G/C/OT/OG) on the franchise roster in that decade with at least one counted season, plus every matched key-list name. Sorted key-list first, then by seasons desc; besides the key-list names only the 15 linemen with the most seasons are kept (omitted = how many were dropped). inKeyList: key-list indexes, or false. heightIn/weightLb/birthDate: median/modal over those seasons (verified, nflverse:rosters).
